questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne til et engelsk talende land hvor der er smuk natur.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var det bedste halve år i mit liv

questions.answer: Meget nemt. Fik mange mails fra mit host uni.

How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Der var en række colleges man kunne søge i prioriteret rækkefølge. Nogle billigere end andre.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Der var dining hall og så delte vi et køkken, men der manglede en del køkkenudstyr.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Jeg var glad for det, fordi jeg mødte en masse venner med det samme. Det var mega convenient.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Det var virkelig nemt hvis man bare læser instruktionerne.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Jeg skrev med det internationale konter fra UWA, da jeg havde nogle spørgsmål. De svarede meget hurtigt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alt hvad jeg ønskede og et skema der passede virkelig godt. I velkomstugen var der en masse hjælp at få til det.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Gør det i god tid, og hvis noget driller så hjælper de rigtig gerne ved UWA-

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Niveaut var ikke så højt som ved KU

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det var meget nemt at følge med. Mere workload under semesteret, men tilgengæld mere chill under eksamen.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Der var mere attendence og mere point at hente under semestret.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Active Leadership
Introduktion to Marketing
Industrial & Organisational Psychology
Organisational Behaviour

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Active Leadership er et mega fedt fag, som handler om at være leder og arbejde godt sammen i en gruppe. I praksis går det ud på at sejle kajak og løse nogle opgaver. Mega sjovt og ikke så stort workload.

questions.answer: Jeg var ikke klar over at student visum koster 8000 kr.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er billigt at købe bil eller rejse med offentligt transport. Housing var dyrt men det var med mad og fitness.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: UWA har 130 klubber. Der er SÅ mange muligheder for at møde mennesker.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg meldte mig til et lacrosse team igennem uni, hvilket jeg virkelig kan anbefale.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: At melde sig i en sportklub!

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Rejs op nord på til Exmouth og syd på til Esperance. De smukkeste steder. Meget smukkere end alt jeg så på østkysten.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Australier er mega nemme og så åbne.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: I undervisningen er det svært, men igennem sport var det mega nemt.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Australier er mega chill og layed back. De har ikke travlt. Det skal man lige vænne sig til.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At alle er så åbne og søde og ikke har travlt.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Køb en bil hvis du har råd. Jeg sparede så mange penge og kom på rigtig mange fede roadtrips. 
Vær åben og snak med folk.
Rejs rundt alt hvad du kan.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ikke andet end det jeg har skrevet

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle minder og den personlige udvikling man kommer igennem.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At turde at gøre det alene.
